name: drachtio-server
what_it_is: A high-performance SIP server built on the sofia SIP stack that can be controlled by Node.js client applications using the drachtio-srf module. It acts as a programmable SIP engine accepting or making TCP/TLS management connections from application code on a dedicated admin port.
components: drachtio executable (SIP engine built on sofia-sip)
Admin TCP/TLS listener (default port 9022) for Node.js app connections
SIP listener (default port 5060, UDP+TCP; optional TLS/WSS)
protocols: HEP3 (Homer Encapsulation Protocol for SIP capture)
HTTP GET (outbound request-handler routing to external HTTP service)
measurement: drachtio_sip_requests_in_total — counter of inbound SIP requests
drachtio_sip_requests_out_total — counter of outbound SIP requests
drachtio_sip_responses_in_total — counter of inbound SIP responses
drachtio_sip_responses_out_total — counter of outbound SIP responses
drachtio_stable_dialogs — gauge of active SIP dialogs
drachtio_proxy_cores — gauge of proxied call setups in progress
drachtio_registered_endpoints — gauge of registered SIP endpoints
drachtio_app_connections — gauge of connected drachtio Node.js applications
drachtio_call_answer_seconds_in/out — histogram of call answer time
sofia_dialogs_total, sofia_server/client_txns_total, sofia_msgs_recv/sent_total, sofia_bad_msgs/reqs_recv_total, sofia_retransmitted_requests/responses_total — sofia stack internals
drachtio_build_info, drachtio_time_started — version and uptime gauges
configuration: Config file (XML): /etc/drachtio.conf.xml or specified with -f flag; precedence: CLI args > env vars > config file
Admin port: <admin port="9022" tls-port="9023" secret="cymru">addr</admin> or DRACHTIO_ADMIN_TCP_PORT / DRACHTIO_ADMIN_TLS_PORT
SIP contacts: <contact>sip:*:5060;transport=udp,tcp</contact> — supports multiple simultaneous addresses/ports/transports
External IP: --external-ip or per-contact ext-ip attribute for NAT/masquerade scenarios
Logging: loglevel (notice/warning/error/info/debug) and sofia-loglevel (0-9) via config, CLI, or DRACHTIO_LOGLEVEL / DRACHTIO_SOFIA_LOGLEVEL
TLS: key-file, cert-file, chain-file, dh-param elements under <sip><tls>
Spammer rejection: <spammers action="reject" tcp-action="discard"> with User-Agent header value matching
MTU size: <mtu-size> to force TCP for large UDP packets
Cloud deployment env vars: CLOUD=(gcp|aws|azure|digitalocean|scaleway|exoscale), DRACHTIO_SIP_PORT, WSS_PORT, TLS_PORT, IMDSv2, LB_IMDS
fault_injection: No built-in fault injection mechanism documented
Spammer/scanner rejection via User-Agent header matching with reject or silent-discard actions
Fail2ban integration available via external ansible role parsing drachtio log files
modes: Inbound mode (default): Node.js apps connect to drachtio admin port; suitable for single-application or primary-function servers
Outbound mode: drachtio makes HTTP GET to an external routing service per incoming request, which returns reject/redirect/proxy/route action; suitable for multi-application servers
Daemon mode: --daemon flag for background process operation
Container mode: console logging default, cloud metadata auto-detection via entrypoint.sh
Cloud-aware mode: --cloud-deployment flag resolves local/public IPs from cloud metadata APIs (GCP, AWS IMDSv1/v2, Azure, DigitalOcean, Scaleway, Exoscale)
constraints: Admin port currently supports TCP and TLS only — no plain UDP management connections
SIP contacts cannot be specified via environment variables (only config file or CLI args)
Outbound request-handler mode currently supports HTTP GET only, not POST
Version 0.9.0+ wire protocol is incompatible with drachtio-srf < 5.0.0
Single executable model: no built-in clustering; horizontal scale requires external orchestration
No native media handling — drachtio is signaling-only; RTP/media requires a separate media server (e.g., FreeSWITCH, rtpengine)
docker_services: drachtio/drachtio-server — single-service image based on debian:bookworm-slim; exposes admin port 9022 and SIP port 5060; configured via /etc/drachtio.conf.xml or CLI args passed to entrypoint
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yml in the repository — the image is designed to be integrated into larger stacks (e.g., with FreeSWITCH, rtpengine) by consumers
No built-in media handling or RTP engine
No built-in registration database — registration state management is delegated to the Node.js application layer
No built-in load balancing or clustering
No REST API — all programmatic control is through the proprietary drachtio wire protocol over the admin TCP/TLS port
